title: Distributed Storage and Workstation Automation
objective: Reason about clustered storage and local provisioning.

sourceAlignment.title: Ansible for DevOps, 2nd Edition
sourceAlignment.author: Jeff Geerling
sourceAlignment.note: Original Code Forge companion material; no book prose is reproduced.

paragraphs: Distributed filesystems require peer membership, bricks, volume creation, mounts, and quorum-aware ordering. Idempotent tasks must distinguish initialization from steady state.
The same Ansible model configures a workstation locally: Homebrew packages and applications, dotfiles, and OS settings. Platform conditions belong behind clean role interfaces.
explanation.rule: Operational rule: Reason about clustered storage and local provisioning.
